about: Every UI component of the Fancy kit, classified for the CMS island catalogue (.ai/plans/charlotte-every-component.md in the envelope). page, chrome and data rows are placeable islands; part rows are placed through the island named in `of`; n/a rows say why they are not placeable. scripts/generate-kit-catalogue.mjs turns the placeable rows into src/kit/catalogue.json from the components' real prop types.
